Data Insight is free for every fellow. Hosting and program costs are covered by ads on this site and by donations.

## Donate

Donation options are being set up and will be listed here.

## Give your time

Experienced practitioners can help as mentors or project reviewers. [Get in touch](contact.qmd).

Fellows and alumni can [publish their projects](contribute.qmd) on this site.
